name: io.github.Seidl-Family/ncrypted
title: ncrypted
description: One-time, end-to-end encrypted secrets for agents. 0.005 USDC per secret via x402.

environmentVariables.name: NCRYPTED_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated Base wallet holding USDC, used to pay 0.005 USDC per secret. Optional: defaults to ~/.config/ncrypted/wallet.key (create with `npx ncrypted wallet new`). Reading is free.
